brief.goal: A three-shot teaser for a hand-thrown stoneware teapot, glazed deep indigo, on a bare plaster shelf.
brief.styleNote: Single soft north light, deep falloff into shadow, muted earth palette, shallow depth of field.

criteria.body: The teapot is unmistakably the hero of every frame
The lighting, glaze colour and surface stay identical across all three shots
Each shot uses a visibly different framing, so the three do not read as one repeated angle
The mood is quiet and unhurried, never busy or commercial

constraints.body: A hand-thrown stoneware teapot is the sole and undeniable subject of every frame.
The teapot's glaze is a consistent deep indigo colour across all shots.
The teapot rests on a bare plaster shelf.
Light emanates from a single, soft north-facing source.
Shadows fall deeply, creating high contrast and chiaroscuro effects.
The colour palette is strictly muted earth tones, with the indigo as the primary accent.
The depth of field is very shallow, rendering the background soft and indistinct.
There is no text or logo visible in any shot.
No additional objects or clutter are present in the frame, beyond the teapot and shelf.
No steam or pouring liquid is depicted.

lessons.body: Vary framing significantly across all three shots. Do not center the teapot identically in each frame.
Ensure the teapot remains the absolute hero and singular focus of every frame.
Maintain identical deep indigo glaze, soft north light, and deep falloff into shadow across all three shots.
Frame the teapot with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing its texture against a softly blurred background.
Ensure consistent light temperature and intensity on the teapot across all shots to maintain identical perceived glaze color.
Render the plaster shelf as a consistent, muted earth tone that complements the indigo glaze without drawing attention.
Utilize a consistent muted earth palette for all background and incidental elements to reinforce the quiet mood.
Maintain the soft, unhurried pacing through deliberate framing choices and lack of distracting elements.
